title.ko: 오병훈 석사과정 연구원, ACCV 2026 논문 게재 확정
title.en: M.S. Student Byunghoon Oh's Paper Accepted to ACCV 2026

body.ko: 오병훈 석사과정 연구원의 논문 「Unlearnable Faces: Privacy Protection Surviving Extraction Pipeline」이 ACCV 2026 Main Track에 accept 되었습니다.
body.en: M.S. student Byunghoon Oh's paper, “Unlearnable Faces: Privacy Protection Surviving Extraction Pipeline,” has been accepted to the ACCV 2026 Main Track.

title.ko: 기태린 학부연구생, IEEE BIBM 2026 Short Paper 논문 게재 확정
title.en: Undergraduate Researcher Taerin Ki's Paper Accepted to IEEE BIBM 2026 (Short Paper)

body.ko: 기태린 학부연구생의 논문 「REAN: Reconstruction-aware ECG Anonymization Based on Privacy–Utility Orthogonality」이 IEEE BIBM 2026 Short Paper에 accept 되었습니다.
body.en: Undergraduate researcher Taerin Ki's paper, “REAN: Reconstruction-aware ECG Anonymization Based on Privacy–Utility Orthogonality,” has been accepted as a short paper at IEEE BIBM 2026.

title.ko: 기태린 학부연구생·김문정 학생, 2026학년도 C.O.R.E. 학술제 장려상 수상
title.en: Undergraduate Researcher Taerin Ki and Munjeong Kim Win Encouragement Award at 2026 C.O.R.E. Academic Festival

body.ko: 기태린 학부연구생과 김문정 학생이 「도로 안전 보완을 위한 WiFi CSI 기반 주차장 사각지대 보행자 감지 인프라 제안」을 주제로 2026학년도 C.O.R.E. 학술제에서 장려상을 수상했습니다.
body.en: Undergraduate researcher Taerin Ki and Munjeong Kim received the Encouragement Award at the 2026 C.O.R.E. Academic Festival for their project, “WiFi CSI-Based Pedestrian Detection Infrastructure for Parking Lot Blind Spots to Enhance Road Safety.”

title.en: Dr. Sunghwan Park Appointed Special Professor at Hoseo University

body.ko: 박성환 박사가 호서대학교 특임교수로 임용되었습니다. 축하합니다!
body.en: Dr. Sunghwan Park has been appointed as a special professor at Hoseo University. Congratulations!

title.en: Undergraduate Researcher Seongyong Ju Joins PwC

body.ko: 연구실에서 학부연구생으로 함께한 주성용 학생이 PwC에 입사했습니다. 축하합니다!
body.en: Seongyong Ju, an undergraduate researcher in our lab, has joined PwC. Congratulations!

title.ko: 장예슬 박사과정 연구원, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track 논문 게재 확정
title.en: Ph.D. Candidate Yeseul Chang's Paper Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Industry Track)

body.ko: 장예슬 박사과정 연구원의 논문 「CARE: Bounded Selective Evidence-to-Judgment Routing for Cost-Aware Document Security Classification」이 EMNLP 2026 Industry Track에 accept 되었습니다.
body.en: Ph.D. candidate Yeseul Chang's paper, “CARE: Bounded Selective Evidence-to-Judgment Routing for Cost-Aware Document Security Classification,” has been accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Industry Track.

title.ko: 장예슬 박사과정 연구원, CIKM 2026 Short Paper 논문 게재 확정
title.en: Ph.D. Candidate Yeseul Chang's Paper Accepted to CIKM 2026 (Short Paper)

body.ko: 장예슬 박사과정 연구원의 논문 「ConRAC-SE: Evidence-Agreement Routing for Cost-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Security Classification」이 CIKM 2026 Short Paper에 accept 되었습니다.
body.en: Ph.D. candidate Yeseul Chang's paper, “ConRAC-SE: Evidence-Agreement Routing for Cost-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Security Classification,” has been accepted as a short paper at CIKM 2026.
